name: claude-context
description: A powerful code indexing tool with multi-platform support

scripts.build: corepack pnpm -r --filter='!./examples/*' build && corepack pnpm -r --filter='./examples/*' build
scripts.release:core: corepack pnpm --filter @zilliz/claude-context-core... run build && corepack pnpm --filter @zilliz/claude-context-core publish --access public --no-git-checks
scripts.release:mcp: corepack pnpm --filter @zilliz/claude-context-mcp... run build && corepack pnpm --filter @zilliz/claude-context-mcp publish --access public --no-git-checks
scripts.release:vscode: corepack pnpm --filter @zilliz/claude-context-core build && corepack pnpm --filter semanticcodesearch run webpack && corepack pnpm --filter semanticcodesearch release
